files.text: A sudden heavy water splash echoes through the flooded forest as a startled river caiman plunges off the muddy bank. The echoes fade. High humidity makes the air feel damp. The guide looks toward the river where the loud splash occurred. Deep dappled canopy shadow conceals stalking predators and resting reptiles from the scorching tropical midday sun. Heat radiates, and bananas grow. The jaguar rests unnoticed within the cool jungle shadow. A torrential tropical rainfall pours down through dense tree canopies, soaking foliage and replenishing vibrant rainforest ecosystems. Rubber trees drip, and bridges sway. The expedition shelters beneath giant leaves during the heavy rainfall.
